text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
(No. 3) Notification 2012
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 6th September 2012 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date "2012" below it and the word "SINGAPORE" in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o'clock of the coin.
The coin design features the 2 giant pandas Jia Jia and Kai Kai in their natural habitat. The panda Kai Kai occupies the foreground of the coin, while the panda Jia Jia is at the back. The denomination is at the right circumference while the weight and fineness of the coin are at the lower circumference.
